svg.title: CODEOWNERS: Last Match Wins, Then the Gate
svg.desc: A pull request touching migrations and payments files is matched against CODEOWNERS from top to bottom, the last matching line names the owner, and the merge waits for that owner only when code owner review is required.
svg.text: CODEOWNERS: Last Match Wins, Then the Gate
Ownership routes the review; 'Require review from Code Owners' makes it mandatory.
